title: Pilot NLP conference talk
text: I am delighted to be joined by Sarah Fletcher today. Sarah, thank you so much for joining me. Thank you. You are presenting at the NLP conference in 2024, the virtual part of the conference, and your presentation is using NLP to transform your business from the inside out. Absolutely. I think we could all do with. So please do start by telling us a little bit more about yourself and your presentation. Oh, thank you, Karen. So yes, so as you already know, I am an NLP trainer and absolutely love training NLP. And I support a lot of people in business, particularly those who have trained in NLP and who want to go and you know, set up their own businesses, sort of NLP sort of coaching, but not necessarily just coaching they might have, you know, a therapy business and they're using NLP within that. But yeah, so my sort of passion is really supporting them to grow their business. And what I've more recently been doing, which has been really exciting, has been working with, I've been working with a lot more local businesses and taking sort of NLP in to, you know, work with staff sort of that communication, those relationships, also supporting business owners in that element of sort of self mastery, you know, really kind of stepping into, you know, their beliefs about themselves and managing their state and just, you know, having that, that whole presence of what it takes really to run a business. Yes, it's not always quite as straightforward as people think, is it? No, no, no, no, no, no, just becoming a NLP practitioner and everything else supporting to place. No, not quite. It's like build a naval comb, no, they don't. A lot of work involved. One of my favourite films that is very NLP. Yeah, absolutely. So, Sarah, what practical learnings will delegates take away from your session? So they'll take away that ability to be able to really believe in their potential for mastering themselves for running a business because it isn't just about, is it the practical sort of, you know, strategy of running a business and what you might need to do on a daily basis? It's about how you organise your thinking, it's about how you manage your own energy, you know, about the things that you, the things that you focus on or not focus on, you know, things like how do you deal with setbacks? How do you make sure that even when you might have been disappointed with something that you still keep going, that you're able to take the learning rather than, you know, get kind of embroiled in that, in what's gone wrong. So it's about that, those self-mastery skills of how do you train yourself, if you like, to keep, keep growing yourself, your own personal development in that kind of mastery state of them being able to run your business in the most successful way that you can. So that's what people are going to be taking away from my session, which I'm really excited to share. Wonderful, thank you. So is there anything that delegates can do before your session so that they get either a deeper understanding of or a deeper experience during your session? Yeah, I think actually what might be useful in very sort of an LP is kind of thinking about what goes really well for them, you know, so when are they finding themselves kind of really achieving the things that they want to do? What's going really well? And what are the things that maybe trip them up? So what might be the things that, you know, get in the way of them being their own, you know, their kind of master of themselves, what gets in the way of them managing themselves in the way that they want to? So that when they come to the session, they've got that frame of about themselves and what's going well, and also thinking about how they can apply what I'm sharing with them to, you know, solve those problems, overcome some of those challenges and difficulties. And yeah, so that they kind of have already primed themselves for taking away that information and to fit it into, hopefully solving some of those issues or problems that they might be experiencing. Wonderful, thank you. So Sarah, what inspired you to want to present at the NLP conference? So I did last year, which I absolutely love. So last year was education. And I'll just love, as you know, Karen, being part of that community, giving something back to the NLP community, getting it out there more into the world, sharing, you know, sharing something that really is a life-changing tool and methodology for people to have in their lives. So I kind of think, well, why wouldn't I want to share that? So for me, you know, my bigger vision, mission, purpose in life is to create as many opportunities as I can to share it with the world. And of course, the NLP conference is the perfect place to do that. So yeah, so it's about sharing more with the world and, you know, just really getting it out there, getting the message out there of how amazing it is and particularly, you know, well, in all areas of life, but with this presentation in business. Yes, wonderful. Thank you, Sarah. So as I mentioned, Sarah is presenting at the virtual element of the conference next year. So you're presenting on Saturday the 10th February at 1400 hours, that before 1400 hours GMT. And your presentation is using NLP to transform your business from the inside out. So thank you so much for joining us, Sarah. Very much looking forward to your session in February. Thank you so much. Really enjoyed this chat. I can't wait to share it.
